tei:div.tei:p: 43)rgyun khyer tshe phur 'don 'grigs la/ phur pa'i las byang gzhung bsrangs nas bsnyen pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' ru// pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*// 'chi med tshe yi mgon po ni/ tshe sgrub yang bcud snying po las/ dmar gsal longs spyod sogs/ gang bar bsam/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ gu ru sogs/ swā hāḥ ci nus bzlas mthar phur pa'i sgrub pa dang las sbyor la 'jug thun grol khar/ tshe sgrub las/ rigs bdag tshe dpag med kyi sogs nas/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: brjod mthar mchod bstod sogs gzhung ltar bya'o/ nyer mkho'i ched du bde ba'i rdo rjes so// 44) gson dang bu mchog tshul khrims rdo rje lags// de ltar gter min brdzun gyi ri mo 'di// bri 'dun mos pa gtan nas med na yang*// grogs mched slob ma rnams kyi chos 'dun dang*// dam ldan skyes bu kar don tshe 'phrang las// thar phyir smon 'dun bzang po'i mthus bskul nas// yid kyi mtsho las 'khrul snang gzugs shar ba// bden med nyams kyi ri mo'i brdzun tshig 'di// chos bdag bu slob tshe chos brtan phyir bris// 'on kyang rang gzhan ngal ba don med dang*// gter gnyis bstan pa'i chom rkun 'gror dogs nas// sems la dam bca' byas kyang bya thabs bral// de bas gos dkar mkha' 'gro'i klong nyid du// thugs babs yod tshe re zhig gsang rgya mdzod// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje'i nges tshig yin/ ha ha// 45)tshogs mchod rgyun gyer tshogs gnyis mthar phyin bzhugs: rgyun khyer tshogs mchod zab mo ni: bza' bca' la sogs ci 'byor bshams: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams klong: shes shing rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: bden 'dzin bral ba'i mchod pa ni: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang: thabs mchog 'di la brtson par bya: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid dag pa dur khrod rol pa'i gnas: gzugs snang dag pa dpal chen ku mā ra:

'dod yon dag pa rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul: 'dzin zhen bral ba'i ngang du bzhes su gsolaḥ myong grol bde ba chen po'i klong du bskangs: gnyis snang 'dzin pa 'dod yon mchod pas bshags: ma rig lam gol ru tra dbyings su bsgral: don dam skye med lha tshogs zhal du bstab: bde stong ye shes chen po'i dngos grub rol: a la la hoḥ rig rtsal ma 'gags mgron rnams lhag mas tshim: rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub nas: sku gsum dag pa'i zhing la spyod par shog: ces pa tshogs mchod rgyun khyer bsdus pa 'di yang dam pa gang gi ngor su kha'i ming gis bris pa'o// 46)bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: phrin las mnga' bdag he ru ka: log 'dren bgegs rnams 'dul mdzad pa: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bkra shis shog: ces dang gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rjes rim gyi: bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis ni: bskyed pa'i lha rnams dmigs med dbyings su bsdu: rjes snang ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru ldang: rtsa sngags brjod: bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis dge tshogs rgyun: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: sa gsum dge ba'i bkra shis gang: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: phan bde dang ni tshul rdor ngor: bde ba'i rdo rjes a mtshar bris: dge'o//
